title: Procure the best-value LLM for a NEAR dApp support agent
description: We are deploying a customer-support agent for a NEAR dApp. It calls tools (wallet lookups, docs search), must answer in structured JSON, and keeps long chat histories. Recommend ONE real model from the NEAR AI Cloud catalog (https://cloud-api.near.ai/v1/models) for an expected monthly workload of 3M input tokens and 1M output tokens. Hard requirements: supports tools and structured_outputs, context length >= 200000 tokens, text in and text out, and the workload must cost <= 3.00 USD at the catalog's live prices. Quote the catalog prices exactly (USD per 1M tokens), compare against the alternatives you considered, and justify the value for money. This is a recommendation: nobody checks out or pays the vendor.

criteria.description: Value for money: compared with the live compliant options under budget, the pick offers strong capability for its workload cost; a much pricier pick needs a convincing capability argument.
Fit for a tool-calling, JSON-answering support agent with long histories, beyond the hard requirements (e.g. reliability of structured output, reasoning needs, latency).
Clear, grounded comparison: quotes real catalog prices and costs, names concrete alternatives, and explains the trade-off without unsupported claims.
